commit_message: Isolate Bloom spread regression from threshold selection
pr_title: Renderer: verify Bloom affects final pixels on current main
pr_body:
## Summary

Keeps the Bloom GPU readback regression coverage test-only and isolates the spatial-spread assertion from Bloom threshold-selection behavior. Production renderer behavior is unchanged.

Two exact-head Windows validations showed the final-pixel toggle test passing while the 4x4 localized source produced zero outside-footprint Bloom delta even when composite intensity was raised from 4 to 64. The Bloom shader applies thresholding during prefilter, before reconstruction and final composite intensity. This correction sets the spread test threshold to 0 so the test measures spatial reconstruction rather than whether the tiny source survives thresholded prefilter averaging.

Visual Validation is N/A.

## Validation

Run exact-head affected Windows Validation for `engine-render-runtime` and use only the result for this PR head.
